auth.keyTyped: Private key file, passphrase typed for this test

origin.passwordStored: The password came from the keychain.
origin.passphraseStored: The passphrase came from the keychain.

network.title: Could not reach {host}
network.detail: {detail}Check the hostname, the port and your network.

timeout.title: No answer from {host}
timeout.detail: The server did not respond within 15 seconds. Check the hostname, the port, a VPN or a firewall.

passwordRejected.title: The server rejected the password
passwordRejected.detail: Check the username, then the password or the secret variable it uses.

keyRefused.title: The server refused the key
keyRefused.detail: Check that its public key is in {file} of {user} on the server, or pick another key.

agentRefused.title: The SSH agent offered no accepted key
agentRefused.detail: {detail}Check that the agent is running and holds a key authorized on the server.

wrongPassphrase.title: Wrong passphrase for {path}
wrongPassphrase.detail: Check the secret variable, or choose “Ask when connecting” and type it.

hostKeyRejected.title: Host key not accepted
hostKeyRejected.detail: Test again and accept the key if the fingerprint matches the one from the server administrator.

hostKeyChanged.title: Host key has changed
hostKeyChanged.detail: The server presents a different key than the one stored for {host}. Confirm it with the server administrator; to replace it, save the host and connect.

hostKeyRevoked.title: Host key is revoked
hostKeyRevoked.detail: The key presented by {host} is marked as revoked in known_hosts. Contact the server administrator.

keyUnreadable.title: Could not read {path}
keyUnreadable.detail: {detail}Check the key path, or pick a registered key.

keychain.title: System keychain unavailable
keychain.detail: Unlock or enable it, or choose “Ask when connecting”.

missingVariables.title: Missing variables
missingVariables.detail: {detail}Define them in the global or project variables.

busy.title: Too many tests are running
busy.detail: Wait for one to finish, then test again.
